acceptance: RED first: TestDifferentialCertificate_ADifferentOutputFailsAndNamesTheFirstInput fails before the change.
Equal outputs on each input give PASS.
A reference path that the cycle diff changes is refused.
Changed functions at 100% coverage on every CI OS; audit-evaluation-contract.md §2.2 and the package note are updated.
fix: Add the certificate kind `differential`: a reference command at a pinned path or commit, a candidate command and an input set. The audit runs both on each input and compares the outputs. A difference is a FAIL that names the first input that differs. The builder cannot change the reference (I-11). The certificate kinds exist only in the spec today; first locate or build the parser of the certificate grammar of audit-evaluation-contract.md §2.2.
summary: The audit certificate kinds are a closed set with no comparison against a reference program (docs/architecture/audit-evaluation-contract.md §2.2). Agensh workers and the ProgramBench grader verify against a reference binary. Research §2.5 P2.11 and P2.12, §3 F3.10.
title: A differential certificate kind: the audit runs a pinned reference and the candidate on the same inputs and compares the outputs.
